name: unifi-status
description: Camera, device, network, and Protect status across UniFi consoles — cloud + local APIs.
long_description:
Connects Claude to three UniFi API surfaces:

- **Site Manager API** (cloud, api.ui.com) — device inventory and online/offline state from anywhere.
- **Network Integration API** (local, on each UDM) — sites, devices, clients, AP/switch/gateway roles.
- **Protect Integration API** (local, on each UDM) — NVR health, recording mode, motion and smart-detect events, snapshots.

The local APIs share one API key per UDM (generate at Settings → Control Plane → Integrations). Tools automatically prefer local data when reachable and fall back to cloud when not. Each result reports which transport answered.

**Tool surface**

Cloud:
- `list_hosts`, `list_sites`, `list_devices`, `camera_status`

Local Network:
- `network_status` — sites/devices/clients/AP-radios

Local Protect:
- `protect_overview` — NVR + camera fleet summary
- `protect_cameras` — per-camera recording mode, smart-detect config, last motion
- `recent_motion_events` — motion events with camera names
- `recent_smart_detects` — person/vehicle/package/animal/license-plate events
- `camera_snapshot` — current still image (inline JPEG)

Diagnostic:
- `transport_status` — which transports are reachable on each console right now

tools.name: list_hosts
tools.description: List all UniFi consoles on the account (cloud).

tools.name: list_sites
tools.description: List all UniFi sites across all hosts (cloud).

tools.name: list_devices
tools.description: List UniFi devices, optionally cameras only (cloud).

tools.name: camera_status
tools.description: Camera status summary — totals, offline list, pending firmware updates (cloud).

tools.name: network_status
tools.description: Rich network status from local Network Integration API (sites, devices, clients, signal-strength distribution, clients-per-AP).

tools.name: network_info
tools.description: Network Controller version + Integration API endpoint-capability probe.

tools.name: device_detail
tools.description: Full per-device JSON from local Network API — ports, radios, WAN config, statistics.

tools.name: client_detail
tools.description: Per-client list with signal strength, AP attachment, link rate. Ranks weakest signal first.

tools.name: protect_overview
tools.description: Protect NVR + camera fleet overview (local Protect API).

tools.name: protect_cameras
tools.description: Per-camera detail: recording mode, smart-detect config, last motion (local Protect API).

tools.name: recent_motion_events
tools.description: Recent motion events with camera names resolved (local Protect API).

tools.name: camera_snapshot
tools.description: Capture a current snapshot from a Protect camera, returned inline as JPEG (local Protect API).

tools.name: transport_status
tools.description: Diagnostic: cloud + Network + Protect reachability for each console. Records latency to history log.

tools.name: latency_trend
tools.description: Read historical latency measurements and report percentiles, trend direction, sparkline.

unifi_api_key.title: Site Manager API Key (cloud)
unifi_api_key.description: Generate at https://unifi.ui.com → API. Required. Stored securely in your OS keychain.

local_consoles_json.title: Local consoles (optional JSON)

allow_self_signed.title: Allow self-signed certs on local consoles
allow_self_signed.description: Set to 'true' to accept UniFi's default self-signed HTTPS cert. Required unless you've installed a real cert on your UDM.
